ps.en: Mr. Lin spent two winters trying to [[patch]] his old coat, and the [[pattern]] he invented to hide the seam proved worth more than the coat. A friend urged him to file a [[patent]] at once.
ps.zh: 林先生花了两个冬天补那件旧外套，为遮缝线想出的图案，竟比外套还值钱。朋友劝他赶紧申请专利。

ps.en: The firm agreed to [[pay]] him a share, and every [[payment]] arrived on time. Yet a [[peculiar]] silence settled among his [[peer]] workers, for [[per]] week the reports showed a rising [[percentage]] of faulty cloth.
ps.zh: 公司答应分他一份收益，每笔款子准时到账。可同僚之间却浮起一种古怪的沉默——报表显示每周次布的比例都在攀升。

ps.en: Nothing there was [[perfect]]: the [[rail]] creaked at every bend, and the [[railroad]] was said to be closing soon. Lin began to [[perceive]] that his invention had cost his friends their work.
ps.zh: 那儿没有一样东西是完美的：铁轨每逢转弯便吱呀作响，那条铁路据传也快关停了。林先生渐渐察觉，自己的发明让老友们丢了活计。

ps.en: Old Chen had learned his craft from a [[master]] who never raised his voice. Now he meant to [[raise]] the standard of every apprentice and to [[rally]] the neighbors to repair the temple gate.
ps.zh: 老陈的手艺得自一位从不提高嗓门的师傅。如今他想把学徒们的水准都抬一抬，召集街坊来修庙门。

ps.en: He picked his helpers at [[random]] rather than by skill, and together they covered a wide [[range]] of talents. His old [[mate]], a man of high social [[rank]], had shared the same bench for twenty years.
ps.zh: 他挑帮手不看手艺，随手点名，一群人的能耐倒是覆盖面够广。他的老搭档地位颇高，两人同台共事二十年。

ps.en: They chose the finest [[material]] they could afford, for a [[masterpiece]] cannot be hurried. With no [[mathematical]] training, Chen judged a beam by its ring, and by the time his taste grew [[mature]] they had built the [[maximum]] a village could hope for.
ps.zh: 他们挑出买得起的最好的料——杰作急不得。老陈没受过数学训练，判一根梁只靠敲下去的那声回响；等到眼力成熟，他们已造出小村所能企及的极致。

ps.en: When the village installed its first turbine, nobody could [[mean]] to explain it, and its [[meaning]] escaped the older farmers. The engineer sought simpler [[means]] of describing how water turns into light; in the [[meantime]] the machine ran on, and [[meanwhile]] the children gathered to watch.
ps.zh: 村里装上第一台水轮机时，没人说得清它意味着什么，年长农户也听不明白它的意义。工程师想找更简单的办法讲水如何变成光；这期间机器照转，孩子们也聚了过来。

ps.en: They learned to [[measure]] its hum against the river's flow, and an [[opening]] in the timetable let the class visit twice a month. Even the old [[opera]] troupe came to sing by its light.
ps.zh: 他们学会用河水流量比对机器嗡鸣，课表腾出的空档让全班每月能来两次。连旧戏班子也来这灯下唱过一回。

ps.en: To [[operate]] such a thing took patience, and the young [[operator]] on duty had none to spare. The whole [[operation]] had been made [[operational]] a week early by one taciturn engineer.
ps.zh: 操作这么个东西得靠耐心，而当班的年轻操作员一点都匀不出来。整个系统由一位寡言的工程师提前一周全面投入运行。

ps.en: In her [[opinion]], the surest [[opportunity]] the town ever had lay in facing the [[opponent]] she had once been too polite to [[oppose]]. Across the [[opposite]] bench sat men ready to [[oppress]] anyone poorer than themselves.
ps.zh: 在她看来，镇子得到过的最可靠的机会，就摆在那个她曾客气得不敢反抗的对手面前。对面席上的人随时准备欺压比他们穷的人。

ps.en: The [[scope]] of her reform was wide and the [[score]] of public support ran high, so few dared to [[scorn]] the plan once the numbers were read aloud. She fought to [[secure]] fair rents, and the [[security]] she promised was not bought with fences.
ps.zh: 改革范围广，民意支持的分值也高，数据当众念过之后，敢鄙视方案的人就不多了。她为公道房租而战，许诺的安全不是用围墙买来的。

ps.en: Others would [[seek]] the same ends by softer roads, and the goal could [[seem]] far off though [[seemingly]] within reach. Plain [[thrift]] funded the work; on the night the vote passed a [[thrill]] ran through the square, the market began to [[thrive]], and the town at last began to [[see]] what she had meant.
ps.zh: 也有人想用更温和的路子求同样的目的，那目标即使看上去近在眼前也仍显得遥远。支撑这项事业的只是朴素的节俭；表决通过那晚一阵激动掠过广场，集市重新兴旺，镇子也终于看清了她一直想做的事。

words.exam: 小块土地；修补；调停；解决
c: patch up a coat 补外套
a patch of land 一小块地
patch a quarrel 平息争执
fam: patchy adj. 拼凑的；不完整的
words.dif: patch 作动词指「修补、调和」；作名词指「补丁、小块地」，阅读里常考小块土地义
words.pat: A small patch on the elbow kept the old coat usable for years.
words.patZh: 手肘上一小块补丁，让这件旧外套又穿了好几年。

words.exam: 专利；专利权；专利的；获得专利
c: apply for a patent 申请专利
patent law 专利法
hold a patent on 持有…的专利
words.dif: patent 多指「发明专利」；copyright 是「著作权」；trademark 是「商标」，三者别混
words.pat: The firm filed a patent to protect its new design.
words.patZh: 那家公司申请了专利以保护自己的新设计。

words.exam: 模式；样式；方式；模仿；仿造
c: a pattern of behavior 行为模式
pattern sth on 仿制…
a floral pattern 花纹图案
words.dif: pattern 名词常考「模式、图案」；作动词 pattern on 表示「仿照」，易与 model 混
words.pat: Sleep follows a clear daily pattern in most people.
words.patZh: 多数人的睡眠都遵循一套清晰的日常规律。

words.exam: 支付；付出；给予（注意）；工资；薪金
c: pay attention to 注意
pay a visit 访问
draw one's pay 领工资
words.dif: pay 作动词常接 attention / a visit；作名词指「工资」，与 wage（周薪）略有别
words.pat: Employers should pay attention to workers' safety.
words.patZh: 雇主应当留意工人的安全。

c: monthly payment 月付
in payment for 作为…的付款
demand payment 要求付款
words.dif: payment 是「支付的款项」；pay 是动词或「工资」总称，搭配时别漏 -ment
words.pat: The monthly payment arrived on time every month.
words.patZh: 每月的款项都准时到账。

words.exam: 奇怪的；古怪的；特有的；独特的
c: a peculiar smell 怪味
peculiar to 为…所特有
a peculiar habit 怪癖
words.dif: peculiar 常考「古怪」与「特有」两层；peculiar to 表示「为…独有」，是高频搭配
words.pat: This dialect is peculiar to the mountain villages.
words.patZh: 这种方言是那些山村所特有的。

words.exam: （身份或地位）相同的人；同辈；仔细看；凝视
c: a peer of one's age 同龄人
peer at 盯着看
peer pressure 同辈压力
words.dif: peer 作名词是「同辈、同侪」；作动词是「凝视」，与 stare / gaze 近义
words.pat: Teenagers are easily shaped by peer pressure.
words.patZh: 青少年很容易受同辈压力影响。

c: per hour 每小时
per person 每人
as per 按照
fam: per capita 人均 n. 相关延伸
per annum 每年 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: per 是介词「每」，常接单位（per hour / per cent）；别与 pace「步伐」混淆
words.pat: The fee is charged per person, not per group.
words.patZh: 费用按人头收，而不是按团体收。

c: perceive a change 察觉变化
perceive danger 意识到危险
perceive as 把…看作
words.dif: perceive 强调「用心感知、领悟」；perceive 与 receive（收到）拼写相近，注意区别
words.pat: We perceive the risk only after the accident happens.
words.patZh: 我们往往在事故发生后才察觉风险。

c: a high percentage of 高比例的
percentage point 百分点
a small percentage 很小的比例
words.dif: percentage 指「百分比这个数」；percent 是「百分之」，后面直接接数字
words.pat: A large percentage of defects points to a real problem.
words.patZh: 很高的次品比例说明存在真问题。

words.exam: 完美的；完全的；使完美；改善
c: a perfect score 满分
perfect one's skill 精进技艺
perfect for 非常适合
words.dif: perfect 形容词「完美的」读 ˈpɜːfɪkt；作动词「使完美」读 pəˈfekt，重音后移
words.pat: Practice alone can perfect a difficult technique.
words.patZh: 唯有练习能把一项难的技术练到完美。

c: a steel rail 钢轨
by rail 乘火车
lean on the rail 倚着栏杆
words.dif: rail 是「一根铁轨 / 栏杆」；railroad / railway 是整条「铁路」，别单复数混用
words.pat: The old rail creaked under the weight of the train.
words.patZh: 那根旧铁轨在列车重压下吱呀作响。

words.exam: 铁路；由铁路运输；仓促行事
c: by railroad 经铁路运送
a railroad station 火车站
railroad a bill through 草草通过议案
words.dif: railroad 美式「铁路」；作动词可指「使议案草草通过」，是僻义
words.pat: Goods were sent by railroad to the coastal port.
words.patZh: 货物经铁路运往海港。

words.exam: 提高；增加；提出；增加（工资）
c: raise a question 提出问题
raise one's voice 提高嗓门
raise salaries 涨工资
words.dif: raise 是及物「提高、举起」（raise prices）；rise 是不及物「上升」（prices rise），易混
words.pat: The report raised a number of hard questions.
words.patZh: 这份报告提出了若干棘手的问题。

c: rally support 争取支持
rally one's friends 召集朋友
a political rally 政治集会
fam: rallied / rallying n. 相关延伸
words.dif: rally 作动词「重新集结、振作」；作名词「群众集会」，与 meeting 近义
words.pat: The mayor tried to rally the town behind the plan.
words.patZh: 市长试图把全镇人团结到这项计划背后。

c: at random 随意地
a random sample 随机样本
random choice 任意选择
words.dif: random 强调「无目的、随机」；arbitrary 强调「武断、凭个人意志」，两者常并列
words.pat: Subjects were chosen at random from the list.
words.patZh: 受试者是按名单随机抽选的。

c: a wide range of 广泛的
range from... to... 从…到…不等
in range 在范围内
words.dif: range 常指「在一定幅度内变动」（prices range from）；scope 指「活动范围、余地」
words.pat: The prices range from ten to fifty yuan.
words.patZh: 价格从十元到五十元不等。

words.exam: 社会地位；级别；排列；分等级；把…分类
c: social rank 社会地位
rank first 排第一
the rank of colonel 上校军衔
words.dif: rank 作名词「等级、军衔」；作动词「把…分等」，与 rate（评估）近义
words.pat: She rose to the top rank in her profession.
words.patZh: 她在自己的行业里升到了最高级别。

words.exam: 能手；大师；精通；掌握；熟练的
c: master a skill 掌握技能
a master of 在…方面的大师
master bedroom 主卧
words.dif: master 可指「主人、大师」或动词「掌握、精通」；与 grasp（理解掌握）近义但更重熟练
words.pat: It takes years to master a foreign language.
words.patZh: 掌握一门外语需要数年之功。

c: a literary masterpiece 文学名著
call it a masterpiece 称其为杰作
his last masterpiece 他的绝笔之作
words.dif: masterpiece 是「杰作、代表作」；classic 是「经典」，未必是某人的巅峰之作
words.pat: The painting is widely seen as his masterpiece.
words.patZh: 这幅画被公认为他的杰作。

c: a close mate 亲密伙伴
a life mate 终身伴侣
classmate 同学
words.dif: mate 泛指「伙伴、同事、配偶」；spouse 仅指「配偶」，语义更窄
words.pat: He remained a loyal mate through hard times.
words.patZh: 在艰难岁月里他始终是个忠实的伙伴。

words.exam: 材料；原料；物质的；实体的
c: raw material 原料
building material 建材
material wealth 物质财富
words.dif: material 名词「材料、原料」；形容词「物质的」，与 physical（物理的）近义
words.pat: The bridge was built from the finest material.
words.patZh: 这座桥是用最上乘的材料建成的。

c: mathematical model 数学模型
mathematical proof 数学证明
a mathematical mind 数理头脑
words.dif: mathematical 是「数学的」；mathematical 与 measurable（可测量的）别混，前者指学科
words.pat: The forecast relies on a mathematical model.
words.patZh: 这项预测依赖一个数学模型。

c: a mature attitude 成熟的态度
mature into 长成
a mature market 成熟市场
words.dif: mature 形容人「成熟」或果实「熟了」；作动词「使成熟」，与 ripe（主要形容果实）有别
words.pat: His judgment grew more mature with age.
words.patZh: 随着年龄增长，他的判断愈发成熟。

words.exam: 最大值；极限；最大的；最高的
c: to the maximum 到最大限度
the maximum speed 最高速度
reach a maximum 达到峰值
fam: minimal / minimum 最小的 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: maximum 是「最大、最高」；minimum 是「最小、最低」，成对出现必考
words.pat: The system ran at its maximum capacity.
words.patZh: 这套系统以最大负荷运行。

words.exam: 表示…的意思；意指；打算；平均的
c: mean to do 打算做
mean a lot 意义重大
the mean value 平均值
words.dif: mean 作动词「意指、打算」；作形容词「卑鄙的、平均的」，多义易混，阅读常考 average 义
words.pat: A low score does not mean you have failed.
words.patZh: 低分并不意味着你失败了。

c: the meaning of life 生命的意义
a hidden meaning 言外之意
deep meaning 深意
words.dif: meaning 是「意义、意思」；sense 也可指「含义」，但 meaning 更偏抽象主旨
words.pat: The meaning of the poem is open to readers.
words.patZh: 这首诗的含义交由读者自己去体会。

c: by means of 借助
a means to an end 达标的手段
by no means 绝不
words.dif: means 单复同形（a means / many means）；by no means 是「绝不」，常考否定强调
words.pat: Education is the chief means of progress.
words.patZh: 教育是进步的主要手段。

c: in the meantime 与此同时
for the meantime 暂时
the meantime 过渡期
words.dif: meantime 与 meanwhile 都表「同时」，meantime 更偏「在此期间」，常作 in the meantime
words.pat: We rested; in the meantime the rain stopped.
words.patZh: 我们歇着，其间雨停了。

c: meanwhile, back home 与此同时在国内
meanwhile the team watched 同时小组在观察
till meanwhile 直到那时
syn: at the same time 同时
words.dif: meanwhile 多作副词「同时」用在句首；meantime 常带 in the，位置搭配略不同
words.pat: The old system ran; meanwhile a team watched.
words.patZh: 旧系统还在跑，同时一支小组在旁观察。

c: measure success 衡量成功
take measures 采取措施
a yardstick to measure 衡量尺度
words.dif: measure 动词「衡量、测量」；名词「措施」（take measures），与 step / action 近义
words.pat: We should measure progress by real results.
words.patZh: 我们应当用实在的成果来衡量进步。

c: an opening in the schedule 日程空档
a job opening 职位空缺
the opening speech 开幕辞
words.dif: opening 名词常考「空缺、机会」；形容词「开头的」，与 vacant（空缺的）近义
words.pat: The firm had an opening for a young engineer.
words.patZh: 那家公司有个面向年轻工程师的空缺。

c: a Beijing opera 京剧
the opera house 歌剧院
enjoy the opera 欣赏歌剧
words.dif: opera 是「歌剧」；operate 是「操作、运转」，同源词形近义远，拼写别混
words.pat: The local opera house borrowed the new machine.
words.patZh: 本地歌剧院借用了这台新机器。

c: operate a machine 操作机器
operate on 给…动手术
operate smoothly 运转顺畅
words.dif: operate 常考「操作、运转、动手术」三义；operate on 后接病人，别漏介词
words.pat: Only trained staff may operate this device.
words.patZh: 只有受过训练的员工才能操作这台设备。

c: in operation 在运转中
a smooth operation 顺利的运转
undergo an operation 动手术
words.dif: operation 可指「运转、操作」或「手术」（undergo an operation）；与 process 近义
words.pat: The whole operation ran without a hitch.
words.patZh: 整场运转进行得毫无阻碍。

c: fully operational 完全投入运行
operational costs 运营费用
operational skill 操作技能
words.dif: operational 是「操作上的、可运转的」；functional 也表「可使用的」，语义极近
words.pat: The unit became fully operational last spring.
words.patZh: 这套装置去年春天完全投入了运行。

c: a machine operator 机器操作员
a telephone operator 接线员
train an operator 培训操作员
words.dif: operator 是「操作人员、接线员」；engineer 偏「设计研发」，职责不同
words.pat: A trained operator ran the night shift.
words.patZh: 一名受过培训的操作员主持了夜班。

c: in one's opinion 在某人看来
a public opinion 公众舆论
have a low opinion of 对…评价低
fam: oplmonpoll 民意调查 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: opinion 表「意见、主张」；view 也指「观点」，但 opinion 更常用在 in my opinion 句式
words.pat: In my opinion, the plan is far too risky.
words.patZh: 在我看来，这方案风险太大了。

c: seize an opportunity 抓住机会
a rare opportunity 难得的机会
equal opportunity 平等机会
words.dif: opportunity 与 chance 近义，但 opportunity 更正式、常指「有利时机」
words.pat: The reform opened a real opportunity for change.
words.patZh: 这场改革带来了真正的变革机会。

c: a worthy opponent 劲敌
defeat an opponent 击败对手
an opponent of the bill 法案的反对者
words.dif: opponent 是「对手、反对者」；rival 偏「竞赛中的竞争者」，语义略窄
words.pat: She faced her old opponent with calm.
words.patZh: 她平静地面对昔日的对手。

c: oppose a plan 反对一项计划
oppose to 反对（be opposed to）
fiercely oppose 强烈反对
words.dif: oppose 是及物「反对」（oppose the law）；object 常接 to（object to），搭配不同
words.pat: Many citizens oppose the new tax.
words.patZh: 许多市民反对这项新税。

words.exam: 相反的；对面的；对立面；对立物
c: the opposite side 对立的一面
quite the opposite 恰恰相反
opposite the station 在车站对面
words.dif: opposite 是「相反的、对面的」；contrary 也表「相反」，但 opposite 更常用作名词「对立面」
words.pat: The truth turned out to be the opposite.
words.patZh: 真相结果恰恰相反。

c: oppress the weak 压迫弱者
feel oppressed 感到压抑
a regime that oppresses 压迫人的政权
words.dif: oppress 强调「压迫、使人沉重」；suppress 强调「镇压、压制（言论）」，对象不同
words.pat: No just society should oppress the weak.
words.patZh: 任何正义的社会都不该压迫弱者。

c: the scope of reform 改革的范围
beyond the scope 超出范围
widen the scope 扩大范围
words.dif: scope 强调「活动范围、余地」（beyond the scope）；range 强调「幅度、区间」
words.pat: The project was wide in scope but short in funds.
words.patZh: 这项目范围很广，资金却不足。

c: a high score 高分
score a goal 进球得分
a score of people 二十人
words.dif: score 名词「分数、二十个」；作动词「得分」，与 mark（批改/分数）近义但词性更广
words.pat: The score of public support kept rising.
words.patZh: 公众支持的分量持续上升。

c: scorn a plan 鄙视某方案
heap scorn on 对…冷嘲热讽
a look of scorn 轻蔑的神情
words.dif: scorn 是「轻蔑、不屑」；contempt 也表「鄙视」，但 scorn 更带「嘲讽」色彩
words.pat: Critics should not scorn a modest proposal.
words.patZh: 批评者不该鄙视一个朴素的提议。

words.exam: 安全的；可靠的；使安全；保卫；获得
c: secure a job 获得工作
feel secure 感到安全
secure the border 保卫边境
words.dif: secure 形容词「安全的」；动词「使安全、获得」，与 safe（仅形容词）不同
words.pat: The policy helped secure both homes and jobs.
words.patZh: 这项政策帮人们保住了家园与工作。

c: social security 社会保障
national security 国家安全
a sense of security 安全感
words.dif: security 是「安全（状态、保障）」；safety 也指「安全」，但 security 偏「防护、安保」
words.pat: Citizens began to feel a real sense of security.
words.patZh: 市民开始感受到真切的安全感。

c: see the change 看见变化
see a doctor 看医生
see sense 明白道理
words.dif: see 多义：看见、理解、会见、经历；read 仅「阅读」，别把 see 与 look（看的动作）混
words.pat: People began to see the good the reform brought.
words.patZh: 人们开始看见改革带来的好处。

c: seek peace 寻求和平
seek advice 征求意见
seek to do 试图做
fam: sought（过去式） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: seek 是「寻求、试图」，较正式；seek to do = try to do，与 search（搜寻具体物）有别
words.pat: Others would seek the same lasting peace.
words.patZh: 别人也会去寻找同样持久的安宁。

c: seem far off 看似遥远
seem to do 似乎做
it seems that 似乎…
words.dif: seem 表「基于推断似乎」；appear 也表「显得」，但 seem 主观推断更强
words.pat: The goal may seem far off, yet it is near.
words.patZh: 目标看似遥不可及，实则近在眼前。

c: seemingly near 仿佛很近
seemingly simple 看似简单
a seemingly odd act 看似古怪的举动
syn: on the surface 表面上看
words.dif: seemingly 是「表面上、看来」；apparently 是「显然、看来」，语气与视角略不同
words.pat: The task was seemingly easy but hard in fact.
words.patZh: 这任务表面容易，实则艰难。

c: quiet thrift 默默节俭
a virtue of thrift 节俭的美德
thrift shop 二手店
words.dif: thrift 是「节俭、节约」；frugality 也表「节约」，thrift 更口语，常指生活习惯
words.pat: Through quiet thrift the family built a small fund.
words.patZh: 靠着默默节俭，这家人攒起了一笔小积蓄。

c: a thrill of hope 一阵希望的激动
thrill the crowd 使人群激动
a thrill of excitement 一阵兴奋
words.dif: thrill 作动词「使非常激动」；作名词「一阵激动」，与 excite（使兴奋）近义但程度更强
words.pat: The news gave him a sudden thrill of excitement.
words.patZh: 这消息让他陡然感到一阵激动。

words.exam: 兴旺发达；繁荣；茁壮生长
c: thrive on 在…中兴旺
thrive in 在…里茁壮成长
a thriving town 兴旺的小镇
fam: thrived / throve（过去式） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: thrive 强调「茂盛、兴旺」；flourish 也表「繁荣」，thrive 更偏生长状态的好转
words.pat: The town began to thrive after the reform.
words.patZh: 改革之后，小镇开始兴旺起来。
